BPM A ssociation Conference
Ontario University A cademic Centre
Saturday, 10 October

Sincerely,

David Okumura

As it happens, we both will be at the BPM A ssociation Conference. I was wondering,
therefore, if we could get together over a cup of coffee. 1 am considering applying for a
position at Brinn Holdings and would love to learn about your experiences there. Would
11:00 work for you? I can't make it earlier as I'll be attending the 10:00 session. If 11:00
is inconvenient, I am available in the afternoon until 3:15. As of 3:30, I'll be assisting a
colleague with her presentation (chances are you don't know her since she joined the
Ligmon Group two weeks after you had left the company). Unfortunately, I have to leave
right after that session. Please let me know if this might be possible.

PROGRAM EVENT FACILITATOR TIME LOCATION
Breakfast buffet; Meet and Miranda Diaz 8:00 AM. Ballroom
greet
The Psychology of Investing Woo Rim Lee 8:30 AM. Conference Room A
Future Technology for Fund Jeff McDougal 10:00 am. Conference Room B
Managers
Lunch (on your own) 11:15 Am-12:30 pm. | [A list of conveniently
located eateries around
campus may be obtained
at the reception desk.]
International Markets and Legal | Ann DiMazzio 12:30 PM. Conference Room A
Compliance
The State of the Banking Sector | Jian Yao 2:00 PM. Conference Room B
The Art of Stock A nalysis Denise Quintero | 3:30 PM. Ballroom
From: | [-dokumura@ligmongroup.ca |
To: | [ wrl86 @brinnholdings.ca |
Date: | [5 October |
Subject: | | Conference |
Dear Mr. Lee,

176. For whom is the conference most likely
intended?

(A) A dvertising executives

(B) Finance industry professionals

(C) University faculty

(D) Computer science majors
177. What will many conference participants
likely do around 11:15 A.m.?

(A) Enjoy a catered buffet

(B) Register for afternoon sessions

(C) Pick up a lunch at the front desk

(D) Select a nearby restaurant for a break

178. What is the purpose of the e-mail?

(A) To arrange a meeting

(B) To inquire about a session

(C) To recommend attending a
presentation

(D) To request a personal introduction

179.

180.

Who works at the same company as
Mr. Okumura?

(A) Miranda Diaz
(B) Jeff McDougal
(C) Jian Yao

(D) Denise Quintero

What does the e-mail suggest about
Mr. Lee?

(A) He is the chairperson of the BPM
A ssociation Conference.

(B) He is looking for a new position.

(C) He was previously employed with the
Ligmon Group.

(D) He is a professor at Ontario University.

@ LSAL
